WITH scores AS ( SELECT explode(from_json(get_json_object(params, '$.similarities'), 'array<struct<tender_description:string,ssic_description:string,similarity:double>>')) AS s, get_json_object(params, '$.model') AS model, CAST(get_json_object(params, '$.max_similarity') AS DOUBLE) AS max_similarity FROM gebiz_pg.rules WHERE flag_id = 'R5' ) SELECT 'R5' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, x.uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'business_description_cosine_similarity' AS metric_name, round(c.s.similarity, 6) AS metric_value, CAST(c.max_similarity AS STRING) AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: tender description "', a.tender_description, '" versus registered activity "', e.primary_ssic_description, '" has cosine similarity ', CAST(round(c.s.similarity, 6) AS STRING), ' below ', CAST(c.max_similarity AS STRING), ' using ', c.model, '. Semantic similarity is a screening heuristic; requires auditor judgement.') AS detail FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name AND x.uen IS NOT NULL JOIN ACRA_FILES.entities e ON e.uen = x.uen JOIN scores c ON c.s.tender_description = a.tender_description AND c.s.ssic_description = e.primary_ssic_description WHERE a.agency = 'Synthetic Review Agency' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND x.confidence >= 0.92 AND c.s.similarity < c.max_similarity ORDER BY c.s.similarity ASC, a.awarded_amt DESC

4c7b8ad717495e30.sql: -- R6: value concentration in ten deterministic keyword categories (first matching category wins). -- Denominator: all positive-value awards in the requested agency, period and category. -- Supplier identity is the published name; aliases are not consolidated. At least five category awards. WITH categorized AS ( SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'landscap|horticultur|arbor|tree |trees|gardening|grass|turf' THEN 'landscaping' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'cleaning|cleansing|pest control|waste|refuse|sanitation' THEN 'cleaning_and_waste' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'cyber|software|computer|network|information technology|data centre|data center|digital|(^|[^a-z])ict([^a-z]|$)|server' THEN 'information_technology' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'security|surveillance|cctv|guarding' THEN 'security' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'training|education|course|workshop|tuition' THEN 'education_and_training' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'consultancy|consulting|audit|legal|valuation|survey' THEN 'professional_services' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'event|festival|catering|exhibition|concert' THEN 'events_and_catering' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'transport|logistic|freight|vehicle|bus service|delivery' THEN 'transport_and_logistics' WHEN lower(tender_description) RLIKE 'construction|building|renovation|civil|structural|engineering|repair|maintenance' THEN 'construction_and_maintenance' ELSE 'other' END AS category FROM gebiz_pg.awards a WHERE agency = 'Synthetic Review Agency' AND award_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND awarded_amt > 0 ), totals AS ( SELECT category, sum(awarded_amt) AS category_total, count(DISTINCT tender_no) AS category_awards FROM categorized GROUP BY category ), supplier_totals AS ( SELECT category, supplier_name, sum(awarded_amt) AS supplier_total FROM categorized GROUP BY category, supplier_name ), concentrated AS ( SELECT s.*, t.category_total, t.category_awards, CAST(s.supplier_total AS DOUBLE) / CAST(t.category_total AS DOUBLE) AS value_share FROM supplier_totals s JOIN totals t ON t.category = s.category WHERE t.category_awards >= 5 AND CAST(s.supplier_total AS DOUBLE) / CAST(t.category_total AS DOUBLE) > 0.5 ) SELECT 'R6' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, x.uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'supplier_category_value_share' AS metric_name, round(c.value_share, 6) AS metric_value, '0.5' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: in keyword category ', a.category, ', this supplier holds S$', CAST(round(c.supplier_total, 2) AS STRING), ' of S$', CAST(round(c.category_total, 2) AS STRING), ' (', CAST(round(c.value_share * 100, 2) AS STRING), '%) across ', CAST(c.category_awards AS STRING), ' category tenders in this scope.', ' Specialised markets and broad categories may explain concentration; requires auditor judgement.') AS detail FROM categorized a JOIN concentrated c ON c.category = a.category AND c.supplier_name = a.supplier_name LEFT JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name ORDER BY c.value_share DESC, a.supplier_name, a.award_date
